training_plan.period: Filing year, not fiscal measurement period; no inferred quarter
training_plan.training: MPNet conservative trial: lr 2e-6, one epoch, validation every 25 steps; previous trained reranker held fixed

baseline.corpus_scope: Original full FinRank first-occurrence exact-text corpus: positives and hard negatives from ALL records
baseline.dense: SentenceTransformer default max_seq_length; normalized vectors and cosine
baseline.metrics: Original per_record_metrics; macro averages multiplied by 100; same np.argsort tie behavior
baseline.note: Quantitative includes direct lookup, calculations and interpretation. No training or gold-answer generation.

benchmark.query_mode: Original questions unchanged; no oracle query metadata or filtering
benchmark.encoding: Source metadata prefix + original passage, all observed sources retained
benchmark.period_semantics: Released document year, NOT fiscal measurement period or quarter
benchmark.truncation: Original model maximum lengths unchanged; prefixes consume some passage token budget

note: Same 376 questions and 5,230 passage IDs; no query metadata or filters. Development benchmark, not an untouched test set. Silver validation selects checkpoints.

trial_config.selection: Highest silver validation MRR; strict improvement over step 0; ties retain earlier checkpoint
trial_config.loss: Same explicit negatives; no in-batch negatives
trial_config.validation: Frozen held-out positive and negative union; designated silver positives, not exhaustive relevance judgments
